Who Are the Dead Who Hear? (John 5:25)

Read in its context, John 5:25 is about living people who are spiritually dead hearing Jesus and coming to life.

Jonathan White

05 Nov 2026 — 4 min read

Truly, truly, I tell you, the hour is coming and has now come when the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God, and those who hear will live.
— John 5:25 (MSB)

Can someone who died without believing in Jesus still hear Him and believe? I understand why that is comforting. But it is not what Jesus is saying. The report of the service says the departed could hear His voice.

1. The Verse Before It Is About the Living
